text:
Maya: Quick follow-up on the ingress retry telemetry RFC. Thinking about a minimal 'plumbline' shim in the gateway to emit synthetic ack/continuation events when we trigger midstream retries so downstream observability can stitch attempts. TL;DR: emit {ingress_id, attempt, ack_offset, reason} on retry start/end. Thoughts?

Chris: Might help observability, but what's the API boundary? Are we changing edge->upstream headers? Or only internal logs/metrics?

Maya: Internal only ideally. Gateway emits events to telemetry pipeline (kafka/otel) — no header changes. We do need a forward-compatible hint header for clients that care, but default is telemetry only.

Devin: If telemetry-only, sampling matters. For high QPS customers we'll overload pipeline. Recommend 1% baseline + dynamic upsampling on anomalies. Also need to include session_token/trace_id to correlate.

Samir: Correlation is key. Use existing `x-rd-trace` header if present, otherwise attach gateway-generated trace id. Event example?

Maya: example:
```json
{
  "ingress_id": "abc123",
  "attempt": 2,
  "event": "retry_start",
  "ack_offset": 2048,
  "reason": "upstream-conn-reset",
  "trace_id": "t-xyz",
  "ts": 1680000000
}
```

Chris: We should define semantics for ack_offset — is it token-level? byte-level? Make it consistent with KV cache checkpoints.

Katie: Token index is better for LLM context. Byte offsets vary across encodings. Token index + model name.

Devin: Agree. Add model and sequence_length fields. Also add `resume_handshake` boolean for resumable streams.

OpsBot: Note: this will add ~0.1 events/request on retries only; current retry rate ~2% -> estimate 0.002 events/request overall. Will monitor kafka backpressure and add throttling if needed.

Samir: What about privacy? Don't include prompt content. Keep only hashes if needed.

Maya: Yep — no PII. Only stable IDs and small ints. Also include sample_rate tag.

Chris: Implementation-wise, add a plumbline handler after retry decision point. It should be async fire-and-forget with backpressure safeguard.

Devin: Pseudocode:
```
if should_retry(req):
  emit_event_async({ingress_id, attempt, ack_offset, reason, trace_id, model})
  initiate_retry()
```

Maya: Rollout plan: feature flag `gateway.plumbline`, 0.1% rollout, metric: events_emitted, correlated_retries_observed. If metrics look good, increment.

Katie: Need docs for customers and runbook for ops. Add ability to disable per-tenant.

Samir: Also capture `fallback_model` when we switch variants.

Maya: Sounds good. I'll draft PR with event schema + feature flag and a small sim harness. @Chris can you own infra changes for kafka topic & retention?

Chris: Yup. I'll make topic: telemetry.gateway.retries.v1 with 7d retention.

Devin: Also add unit test that ensures no content/prompt leakage.

Maya: Great — creating RFC follow-up issue. Thanks :thumbsup:

OpsBot: Created issue: https://redwood.internal/issue/INC-4392
